objective: Derive the Console model update verdict from Workspace configuration readback after an attention-required operation, without confusing closeout obligations with applied configuration.

taskReference.scope: A regression in the existing Console model configuration surface, not work-package or business-chain completion.

necessity.currentProblem: The controller classified a needs_attention operation as an unapplied configuration without reading the configuration owner. A successfully reloaded model update whose superseded key could not be revoked was shown as not applied.
confirmedFacts: Workspace confirmModelConfiguration marks the configuration reload confirmed and advances the applied version before revokeSupersededKey.
The revoke failure path calls finishModelUpdate, which writes workspace.operations only. The configuration remains applied; it is not downgraded to configuration-level needs_attention by that path.
The Console must read configuration after the terminal operation and preserve generation/session/workspace scope checks.
necessity.selectedAuthority: Workspace owns applied configuration and operation readbacks. Console owns presentation only.
necessity.discardedExplanation: The earlier equal-version configuration-level needs_attention promotion was not justified by the current revoke-failure path and is not included.

verifiedSource.unchangedInputs: Other tracked inputs are the exact base commit; dependencies use its unchanged package lock. No test/framework/package script was added.

redGreen.evidence: Two assertion failures and two bounded missing-readback response timeouts against the unmodified baseline controller.

redGreen.evidence: All four regressions pass against the accepted controller, including page refresh, navigation, and visible readback errors.

verification.runnerClaims: Actual command exit codes and test summaries were checked; worker completion text was not accepted as execution evidence.

acceptance: An attention-required operation with applied equal-version configuration renders applied without the unapplied alert, and stays correct after page reload.
An unapplied configuration retains its failure alert and requires the actual configuration re-read.
A late readback after leaving the models route does not replace the active route; returning reads current applied facts.
An undecodable configuration readback displays its read error and unconfirmed verdict, not a false unapplied verdict; the already read terminal operation is not erased.
The rejected intent is cleared before the second read; original generation/session/workspace guards remain.
The new regressions reuse existing test files in the source/browser CI inventories.
